name: Mara Chu
description: Mara is a short human woman with short black hair pulled back in a bun, dressed in inexpensive clothing, well cared for.

aspects.name: Head filled with stories about Union Busting
aspects.description: Mara's grandfather was a union-busting Pinkerton-type, and she grew up listening to his "war stories", featuring the "villainous mastermind" Dwabit. She is a newly-badged private security officer, completely naive to which side of history she's joining.

extras.name: Mara's relationship with...
extras.description:
This extra tracks the relationships between Mara Chu and other characters over time.

The relationship with each other character is tracked by a series of stress boxes, an "empty" Aspect that applies when no stress boxes are checked, and a "full" Aspect that applies when all the stress boxes are checked.

fullAspect.name: Bring Him In, Dead or Alive
